turn.subject: solution
turn.user_message: Show me the changes on the wards

text: Most of the work stays the same. What changes is when it starts, and who writes it. Why these changes:
bullets: Starting in the evening only works if each team knows it has started, so the software tells them.
Staff approve instead of writing, so nobody does the same work twice.
The discharge papers are the biggest hold-up today, so they change the most.
chat.invite: Next is the people who must agree, and who has the most to give up. Shall we go there?
chat.note: Same steps. They just start the night before.

items.title: One team for leaving and arriving
items.text: The two jobs queue behind each other every morning.
more_points: Split the work into two teams, one for patients leaving and one for patients arriving.
Or run both at the same time, so admissions don’t wait for discharges to finish.
Either way it costs nothing but agreeing the new order. The Head of Operations signs it off.

items.title: What other teams watch for
items.text: The software tells each team when it is their turn.
more_points: The bed desk: when a bed will be free, and when the next patient arrives.
Pharmacy: which medicines are coming back.
The dietitian: which families need a diet talk before leaving.
Housekeeping and transport: when to clean the bed and bring the wheelchair.
